params.statement: Burp 52685's browser crawler prunes links by crawl strategy (enum burp.Zmqs, Crawl strategy setting; default NORMAL). Each strategy is a parameter set, read from Zmqs.<clinit> and dumped by reflection. NORMAL: unmatchedAnchorTolerance=2, totalUnmatchedActionDescriptorTolerance=2, incomingUrlActionDescriptorMaskingThreshold=1, page/loopback masking=2, maxLocationsPerUrl=10. MOST_COMPLETE: tolerances 0, masking 2/4/4, maxLocationsPerUrl=20. FASTEST: incyWincy, tolerances 3, maxLocationsPerUrl unlimited. A link whose action descriptor matches one already explored past the tolerance is not visited. On Juice Shop an uncapped NORMAL crawl (fresh project, 2026-11-16) visited 21 locations and skipped /ftp/legal.md and /ftp/announcement_encrypted.md, which have the same response shape as acquisitions.md. The 10-minute cap was not the cause.

evidence_against: The earlier 'followed no links on a plain test site' observation came from the legacy crawler (embedded browser disabled as root), not the browser crawler.
evidence_for: fnd_82: the crawl strategy enum burp.Zmqs (Zmqs.<clinit>, evidence ev_5bdaa08d…) defines per-strategy link-pruning tolerances; the default NORMAL allows 2 unmatched anchors and masks repeated URL actions, so equivalent links (legal.md, announcement_encrypted.md next to acquisitions.md) are skipped. An uncapped fresh-project crawl shows the same 21 locations.

params.resolution: RESOLVED (2026-11-16): the rule is Burp's crawl strategy (enum burp.Zmqs, default NORMAL). Its link-pruning tolerances (unmatchedAnchorTolerance=2, total unmatched actions 2, URL-action masking threshold 1, maxLocationsPerUrl=10) make the crawler skip links whose action descriptors match ones already explored. /ftp/legal.md and /ftp/announcement_encrypted.md fall under that. An uncapped fresh-project Burp crawl of Juice visits the same 21 locations, so the 10-minute cap was not the cause. The 'no links on a plain test site' observation came from the legacy crawler (browser disabled as root). See fnd_82. WebProbe follows every link (a superset); porting the masking itself needs the crawl-graph engine (net.portswigger.crawlgraph), which is not decompiled.

params.statement: D-03 insertion points: burp.Zuq.Zs builds points in this order: entire body (XML/JSON), URL and body params (Zuq.Ze; Ze9r maps COOKIE to the case Ze skips), cookies (Zuq.Zy), every X-* header present (Zuq.ZP searches '\r\nx-'), nested/XML-tag/param-name points, User-Agent and Referer (existing value, or synthesised https://example.com/ by Zuq.ZE), URL path folders (ZX), URL path filename (ZY). Path folders are numbered per non-empty segment (Zhjs.ZK). The 30-point cap is the last Zwez veto (count >= max -> VETOED_DUE_TO_LIMIT) after the skip-list filters (cookies _ga, _gid, _gat, _ga_*, _gac_*, AWSALB*).

PHP code injection, echo-based (Zsn3 -> Zgeo.Zv -> Zi0f/Zpza -> Zxvv) runs only on file-upload insertion points (Zcgg.Zw is true only for Ziqg multipart parts with a filename), not 'only when input is reflected'. It uploads <orig><token[2..12]>.php as text/plain with <?php printf("ONE".(7*6)."TWO");?> where ONE/TWO are the last 10 chars of the token shifted 17/18 places in a-z0-9 (Zcub), and reports PHP code injection (High, Certain: Zbr5.Zs bytes 3/4) when ONE+"42"+TWO (Zg1y.a = "42") appears in the response or its redirect chain (Zcgg.ZI). Zsn3 also starts the timing engine Zwj_, which is not ported.

Cross-site scripting (stored): burp.Zi6p.ZZ runs the same breakout engine as reflected XSS when the sender is a stored (injection + retrieval) context; Zwwb.Zv gives XSS_STORED severity High (Info when the retrieval is a 3xx). Zwwb.Zv also lowers reflected XSS to Low on HTTP header points and Medium on cookie points.

Client-side template injection (burp.Zrmh): payload m1 + '{{a=(7*7.0)}}' + m2 (Zrmh.Zi decoded from <clinit>); gated on the plain reflection sitting in a text or attribute-value context (Zcle.ZA) inside an ng-app element range and outside ng-non-bindable (Zg1t); reported when the HTML-decoded m1..m2 span still holds the expression (Zmh4.Zf). Severity High; confidence Firm when a page script shows (AngularJS v[0-9.]+) (Zr54), else Tentative (Zgum).

XML injection, Collaborator half (Zp7s -> Zsrh): for values without markup on non-header points (Zxmw.Zl excludes HEADER and param-name kinds), the value is replaced by <tag xmlns="http://a.b/" xmlns:xsi=... xsi:schemaLocation="http://a.b/ http://HOST/tag.xsd">tag</tag> (Ze_f) and then by <tag xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude"><xi:include href="http://HOST/foo"/></tag> (Zbiw), built by Zsdg with a random 3-letter tag. An interaction later maps through Zc3f (Zs_g.XML_INJECTION) to Zp9s.ZC: XML injection, Medium, Certain.
